Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 array_dimension: 0:1 cat_description: Total angle between antenna used for WBD measurement and measured B field direction caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 dataset_id: C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Instrument error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Antenna-B Field Total Angle fillval: -1.0E+31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-4 (Tango) Launched: 9 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 4 COSPAR ID: 2000-045B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26464 CSDS Code: C4 ESOC FD code: S4 ESA Flight Model Number: FM8 WBD Experiment on Cluster C4 High time resolution calibrated waveform data sampled in one of 3 frequency bands in the range 0-577 kHz along one axis using either an electric field antenna or a magnetic search coil sensor.  The dataset also includes instrument mode, data quality and the angles required to orient the measurement with respect to the magnetic field and to the GSE coordinate system. ... The Burst Mode (BM) dataset contains the data that has been returned via the main Cluster telemetry system using BM2. The format of the file is the same as the waveform product returned via the dedicated communication link except that there is an additional paramter providing information on the data sampling and bandwidth relevant for the BM2 link. ... CALIBRATION: ... The procedure used in computing the calibrated Electric Field and Magnetic Field values found in this file can be obtained from the document CAA-EST-CR-WBD (Calibration Report of the WBD Measurements in the Cluster Science Archive). In the same document are decribed the procedures to calculate power spectra and to invert the calibration to obtain raw instrument data. ... Bandwidth   Sample Rate ---------   ------------ 0.1 - 9.5 kHz      27.443 kHz 0.1 - 19 kHz       54.886 kHz 0.7 - 77 kHz      219.544 kHz ... COORDINATE SYSTEM USED: ... The data contain a projection of the electric or magnetic field vector into the direction of the selected receiving antenna (indicated by the Antenna variable). While Bx magnetic antenna points along the spin axis of the spacecraft, antennas Ey, Ez and By are in the spin plane and rotate with spacecraft spin. The instantaneous direction of the antenna in GSE coordinate system can be calculated from the angles in variables Ant_Xgse_Angle and Ant_YZgse_Angle. ... The burst mode file has the same format as the standard WBD waveform with the addition of an additional paramter which describes the details of the mode specification. The paramter can take one of ten values as specified below 0 = Duty Cycled 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 27.443 kHz 1 = Duty Cycled 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 27.443 kHz 2 = Duty Cycled 19 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 54.886 kHz 3 = Duty Cycled 19 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 54.886 kHz 4 = Duty Cycled 77 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 219.544 kHz 5 = Duty Cycled 77 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 219.544 kHz 6 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, roll-off at 3.2 kHz, SR 9.148 kHz 7 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, optimized roll-off at 4.2 kHz, SR 9.148 kHz 8 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, roll-off at 2.5 kHz, SR 6.861 kHz 9 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, optimized roll-off at 3.1 kHz, SR 6.861 kHz ... label_axis: Ant-B Ang parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 0:time_tags__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 parameter_id: Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 parameter_label:  parameter_representation:  property: Status provider: csa quality: 0 scale_type:  si_conversion: 0.01745>rad significant_digits: 5 speasy_id: csa/C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 stable_id: csa/C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  uid: C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 units: degrees value_type: FLOAT

DoubleStar-1 (D1) Launched: 2003-12-29 COSPAR ID: 2003-061A USSPACECOM catalogue number 28140 DSDS Code: T1 Orbit: 570 x 78,970 km, inclination 28.5 degrees to the equator  Double Star 1 (also known as Tan Ce 1, and TC 1) is a Sino-European (CSNA-ESA) satellite that was launched by a Long March 2C/SM rocket from Xichang Satellite Launch Center in the Sichuan province of China (PRC) at 19:06 UT on 29 December 2003. The 330 kg, 260 W satellite is cylindrical, with a diameter of 2.1 m, a height of 1.4 m, and spins at a rate of 15 rpm. It carries eight instruments to probe Earth's magnetosphere, five from ESA and three from CNSA. The ESA instruments are legacies from ESA's Cluster mission. The data from all instruments will be stored on-board and dumped over three grounds stations: Shanghai and Beifing in China, and Villafranca in Spain. For more information, see https://sci.esa.int/web/double-star  In the early morning on 14 October 2007, the satellite re-entered the Earth's atmosphere and disintegrated during its descent. BackgroundLevel__C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:64, 1:12, 0:16 cat_description: Background level data for 'Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux' caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DXLAR background level fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This dataset contains all available 3DF, 3DX and 3DXE data from the PEACE HEEA sensor on the Cluster C3 spacecraft in LAR mode only. This dataset is NOT summed over polar angle but can in some cases be summed over energy.  Including: - The 3DF dataset contains FULL resolution three dimensional electron distribution. - The 3DX1 and 3DX2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution with no summing. - The 3DXE1 and 3DXE2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution which has been summed over pairs of ENERGY bins.  For the 3DX in LAR mode the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will be 16 azimuths x 12 polar angles x 64 energy bins. label_axis: Diff. BackgroundLevel__C2_CP_PEA_3DRL_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:16, 1:6, 0:16 cat_description: Background level data for 'Data__C2_CP_PEA_3DRL_DEFlux' caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C2_CP_PEA_3DRL_DEFlux dataset_id: C2_CP_PEA_3DRL_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DR background level fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-2 (Salsa) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 2 COSPAR ID: 2000-041B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26411 CSDS Code: C2 ESOC FD code: S2 ESA Flight Model Number: FM6 From 15th May 2011 the C2 LEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 2 of 12), while the C2 HEEA instrument is fully operational and the DPU's are operating nominally in dual processor mode. This dataset contains reduced resolution three dimensional electron distributions (3DR) from the PEACE LEEA sensor on the Cluster C2 spacecraft. This data product is usually produced onboard and is reduced by a factor of 8 from the full resolution 3DF product, but if not telemetered it can also be generated from higher resolution data in ground processing. For all energy sweep modes (LAR/MAR/HAR) the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will always be 16 azimuths x 6 polar angles x 16 energy bins.  For all energy sweep modes, the 12 polar anodes are summed to make 6 anode-pairs. The remaining compression is achieved in the following way: - LAR sums 4 energies to a bin and 1 (3DF) azimuth  to get a single 3DR azimuth. - MAR sums 2 energies to a bin and 2 (3DF) azimuths to get a single 3DR azimuth. - HAR does not sum energy bins but 4 (3DF) azimuths to get a single 3DR azimuth.  The effective time resolution of the data is reduced due to these summations. Where a variable higher resolution dataset was used to generate the 3DR records there may be fill values in some energy bins. label_axis: Diff. Data__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXH_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:32, 1:12, 0:64 cat_description: C3 PITCH_3DX HEEA (DEFlux), 12 PA bins caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXH_DEFlux dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXH_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: PITCH_3DX fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This data product contains rebinned pitch angle distributions from a single (HEEA) sensor for the Cluster C3 spacecraft. The data is provided in the same format as the 3D data, except that the 12 polar zones are rebinned into 12 pitch angle zones using ground calibrated magnetic field data. Only MAR and HAR sweep modes are included. label_axis: Diff. geomagneticFieldH dataset: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec0p1_kny description: Horizontal VARIATION along the magnetic meridian (northward+), in nT. Not an absolute value: no baseline is included. Not corrected for the frequency response of the recording system. fill: 99999.0 instrument_description: HAPI server for the World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. Provides geomagnetic indices and geomagnetic observatory data. Kanoya (KNY) 0.1-second geomagnetic field variations (H, E, Z) recorded by the Kakioka Magnetic Observatory, Japan Meteorological Agency. H, E and Z are VARIATION components in nT, where H is along the magnetic meridian (northward+), E is the magnetic eastward variation in nT (not minutes of arc) and Z is vertical (downward+). They are not absolute field measurements and carry no baseline: use them for variations, not for absolute levels, and do not compare levels between stations or across time. The values are served as recorded and are NOT corrected for the frequency response of the recording system: the source supplies sensitivity tables (amplitude and phase against period, 1 to 200 s) whose amplitude factors are close to 1 at periods of a few to tens of seconds but grow to about 3 at 200 s, so long-period variations are recorded smaller than they are. Timestamps are the sample times of the source (timeStampLocation=center). Variation data without baseline, as recorded. label: H name: geomagneticFieldH provider: hapi speasy_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec0p1_kny/geomagneticFieldH stable_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec0p1_kny/geomagneticFieldH start_date: 1996-06-01T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z type: double uid: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec0p1_kny/geomagneticFieldH units: nT x_digits: 3

sc_at1_lat__C1_CP_CIS_HIA_ONBOARD_MOMENTS_INERT array_dimension: 0:1 cat_description: Latitude of spacecraft spin axis, angle from Ecliptic Plane (GSE), taken from CSDS SP caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system: GSE data_type: Data dataset: C1_CP_CIS-HIA_ONBOARD_MOMENTS_INERT dataset_id: C1_CP_CIS-HIA_ONBOARD_MOMENTS_INERT delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Observatory error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Latitude of spacecraft spin axis, angle from Ecliptic Plane (GSE) fillval: -1e+31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-1 (Rumba) Launched: 09 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 1 COSPAR ID: 2000-045A USSPACECOM catalogue number 26463 CSDS Code: C1 ESOC FD code: S1 ESA Flight Model Number: FM5 CIS Hot Ion Analyser on Cluster C1. HIA consists of two sections, each with a 180 degrees field of view: A high-sensitivity (HS) side and a low-sensitivity (LS) side. The LS side supplies data only during solar wind modes and during solar wind/upstreaming ions modes, and covers a 45 x 45 degrees solid angle centred in the solar wind arrival direction. The HS side operates during magnetospheric modes and during solar wind/upstreaming ions modes. During magnetospheric modes the HS side covers the full space. During solar wind/upstreaming ions modes the HS side covers the remaining space not covered by the LS side. cf. the CIS User Guide for details This dataset has been derived from C1_CP_CIS-HIA_ONBOARD_MOMENTS dataset. The velocity moments in the present dataset are given in both GSE and ISR2 coordinate systems in inertial frame whereas in C1_CP_CIS-HIA_ONBOARD_MOMENTS they are in GSE in spacecraft frame. In addition spin-averaged E-field is given in both ISR2 and GSE in inertial frame. Data__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXPAL_DPFlux array_dimension: 2:32, 1:12, 0:64 cat_description: C3 PITCH_3DXPA LEEA (DPFlux), 12 PA bins caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXPAL_DPFlux dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXPAL_DPFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: PITCH_3DXPA fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This data product contains rebinned pitch angle distributions from a single (LEEA) sensor for the Cluster C3 spacecraft. The data is provided in the same format as the 3D data, except that the 12 polar zones are rebinned into 12 pitch angle zones using ground calibrated magnetic field data. geomagneticFieldZ dataset: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_sga description: Vertical (downward+) component VARIATION. Not an absolute value: the baseline is approximate or absent (see the dataset description). fill: 99999.0 instrument_description: HAPI server for the World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. Provides geomagnetic indices and geomagnetic observatory data. Shigaraki (SGA) 1-second geomagnetic field variations (H, E, Z, F) from a station operated by WDC for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. H, E and Z are VARIATION components, where E is the magnetic eastward variation in nT. The baseline is not accurate and is not controlled over time, so these are not absolute field measurements: at some stations no baseline is added at all and H is only of the order of tens to hundreds of nT, while at others only an approximate value has been added (the source's approximate baseline for each station is reproduced in the comment block of the IAGA2002 output). That baseline is what the source supplies for transforming the reported elements: D is needed to transform the HEZ variation data to the widely used XYZ orientation, and H to convert E-variations in nT to variations in minutes of arc. Use the data for variations, not for absolute levels, and do not compare levels between stations or across time without establishing your own baseline. The data were collected for real-time monitoring and are served as recorded: no noise removal, spike rejection or baseline control has been applied. Caution: timestamps may be inaccurate during periods when GPS timing or the network connection was unavailable and the recording PC's clock was used instead. Timestamps are bin centers (timeStampLocation=center). Real-time monitoring data, unprocessed. label: Z name: geomagneticFieldZ provider: hapi speasy_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_sga/geomagneticFieldZ stable_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_sga/geomagneticFieldZ start_date: 2009-01-01T00:00:00Z stop_date: 2017-05-16T00:00:00Z type: double uid: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_sga/geomagneticFieldZ units: nT

DoubleStar-1 (D1) Launched: 2003-12-29 COSPAR ID: 2003-061A USSPACECOM catalogue number 28140 DSDS Code: T1 Orbit: 570 x 78,970 km, inclination 28.5 degrees to the equator  Double Star 1 (also known as Tan Ce 1, and TC 1) is a Sino-European (CSNA-ESA) satellite that was launched by a Long March 2C/SM rocket from Xichang Satellite Launch Center in the Sichuan province of China (PRC) at 19:06 UT on 29 December 2003. The 330 kg, 260 W satellite is cylindrical, with a diameter of 2.1 m, a height of 1.4 m, and spins at a rate of 15 rpm. geomagneticFieldZ dataset: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_agw description: Vertical (downward+) component VARIATION. Not an absolute value: the baseline is approximate or absent (see the dataset description). fill: 99999.0 instrument_description: HAPI server for the World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. Provides geomagnetic indices and geomagnetic observatory data. Agawa (AGW) 1-second geomagnetic field variations (H, E, Z, F) from a station operated by WDC for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. H, E and Z are VARIATION components, where E is the magnetic eastward variation in nT. The baseline is not accurate and is not controlled over time, so these are not absolute field measurements: at some stations no baseline is added at all and H is only of the order of tens to hundreds of nT, while at others only an approximate value has been added (the source's approximate baseline for each station is reproduced in the comment block of the IAGA2002 output). That baseline is what the source supplies for transforming the reported elements: D is needed to transform the HEZ variation data to the widely used XYZ orientation, and H to convert E-variations in nT to variations in minutes of arc. Use the data for variations, not for absolute levels, and do not compare levels between stations or across time without establishing your own baseline. The data were collected for real-time monitoring and are served as recorded: no noise removal, spike rejection or baseline control has been applied. Caution: timestamps may be inaccurate during periods when GPS timing or the network connection was unavailable and the recording PC's clock was used instead. Timestamps are bin centers (timeStampLocation=center). Real-time monitoring data, unprocessed. label: Z name: geomagneticFieldZ provider: hapi speasy_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_agw/geomagneticFieldZ stable_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_agw/geomagneticFieldZ start_date: 2012-04-02T00:00:00Z stop_date: 2021-11-18T00:00:00Z type: double uid: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_agw/geomagneticFieldZ units: nT

Data_Pressure_GSE__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS array_dimension: 1:3, 0:3 cat_description: C3 MOMENTS GSE Pressure tensor (P) caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system: GSE>Geocentric Solar Ecliptic data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: C3 PEA: MOMENTS GSE Pressure fillval: -1.0E31 fluctuations:  frame: vector>gse_xyz frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This data product contains the electron moments for the PEACE HEEA and/or LEEA sensors on the Cluster C3 spacecraft. label_axis: C3 PEA: MOMENTS GSE Pressure parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 0:time_tags__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS parameter_id: Data_Pressure_GSE__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS parameter_label: 2:"z", 2:"y", 2:"x", 1:"z", 1:"y", 1:"x" parameter_representation: 1:"x", "y", "z", 2:"x", "y", "z" property: Pressure_Tensor provider: csa quality: Status_Quality__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS scale_type:  si_conversion: 1.0E-9>Pa significant_digits: 8 speasy_id: csa/C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS/Data_Pressure_GSE__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS stable_id: csa/C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS/Data_Pressure_GSE__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  tensor_order: 2 uid: C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS/Data_Pressure_GSE__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS units: nPa value_type: FLOAT

EE_xxyy_sr2__C4_CP_STA_PSD array_dimension: 1:2, 0:27 cat_description: Power spectrum 8-4000 Hz of the E-field components along the SR2 coordinate axes caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system: SR2 data_type: Data dataset: C4_CP_STA_PSD dataset_id: C4_CP_STA_PSD delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electric_Field error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Electrical Power Spectral Density fillval: -1.00E+31 fluctuations:  frame: SR2>xyz frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-4 (Tango) Launched: 9 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 4 COSPAR ID: 2000-045B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26464 CSDS Code: C4 ESOC FD code: S4 ESA Flight Model Number: FM8 The STAFF Spectrum Analyser (SA) combines the 3 magnetic components of the waves with the two electric components measured by the EFW experiment to calculate in real time the 5x5 Hermitian cross-spectral matrix at 27 frequencies distributed logarithmically in the frequency range 8 Hz to 4 kHz. The components in the spin plane are despun onboard. The five auto-spectral power estimates are obtained with a dynamic range of approximately 100 dB and an average amplitude resolution of 0.38 dB. The 10 cross-spectral power estimates are normalised to give the coherence. The precision of the phase depends upon the magnitude of the coherence: for a signal with magnitude in the highest bin, it is approximately 5 degree close to 0 degree, 180 degree, and +/- 90 degree, increasing to about 10 degree midway between these angles. The Spectrum Analyser can work in different modes, in Burst Mode the analysis is performed in the frequency range 64 Hz - 4 kHz. Power Spectral Density measurements of three components of the magnetic field and two components of the electric field in SR2 reference frame, at 27 frequencies logarithmically distributed between 8 Hz and 4 kHz. The time resolution can vary between 0.125 and 0.250s in High Bit Rate and usually 1s (exceptionally 0.5 and 2s) in Normal Bit Rate telemetry mode. label_axis: Electrical Power Spectral Density parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 1:Frequency__C4_CP_STA_PSD, 0:Time__C4_CP_STA_PSD parameter_id: EE_xxyy_sr2__C4_CP_STA_PSD parameter_label: 2:"Ey^2", 2:"Ex^2" parameter_representation: 2:"xx", "yy" property: Vector provider: csa quality: 3 scale_type:  si_conversion: 1.0E-6>V^2 m^-2 Hz^-1 significant_digits: 3 speasy_id: csa/C4_CP_STA_PSD/EE_xxyy_sr2__C4_CP_STA_PSD stable_id: csa/C4_CP_STA_PSD/EE_xxyy_sr2__C4_CP_STA_PSD start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  tensor_order: 2 uid: C4_CP_STA_PSD/EE_xxyy_sr2__C4_CP_STA_PSD units: mV^2 m^-2 Hz^-1 value_type: FLOAT

Cluster-4 (Tango) Launched: 9 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 4 COSPAR ID: 2000-045B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26464 CSDS Code: C4 ESOC FD code: S4 ESA Flight Model Number: FM8 CIS COmposition DIstribution Function analyser on Cluster C4. CODIF consists of two sections, each with a 180 degrees field of view: A high-sensitivity (HS) side and a low-sensitivity (LS) side. The HS side is best adapted for low-flux populations, as for example in the magnetosphere or the upstreaming populations in the foreshock region. The LS side is best adapted for high-flux populations, as for example in the magnetosheath and in the solar wind (solar wind beam), where the HS side can saturate. Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPALARH_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:64, 1:12, 0:2 cat_description: C3 3DXPALAR HEEA (DEFlux), 12 Zones caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_3DXPALARH_DEFlux dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_3DXPALARH_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DXPALAR fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This dataset contains all available 3DXPA data from the PEACE HEEA sensor on the Cluster C3 spacecraft in LAR mode only. The 3DXLAR product contains only the 3DX azimuths that are aligned parallel and anti-parallel with the onboard magnetic field direction.  For the LAR mode the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will be 2 azimuths x 12 polar angles x 64 energy bins. label_axis: Diff. geomagneticFieldZ dataset: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_mya description: Vertical (downward+) component VARIATION. Not an absolute value: the baseline is approximate or absent (see the dataset description). fill: 99999.0 instrument_description: HAPI server for the World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. Provides geomagnetic indices and geomagnetic observatory data. Mineyama (MYA) 1-second geomagnetic field variations (H, E, Z, F) from a station operated by WDC for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. H, E and Z are VARIATION components, where E is the magnetic eastward variation in nT. The baseline is not accurate and is not controlled over time, so these are not absolute field measurements: at some stations no baseline is added at all and H is only of the order of tens to hundreds of nT, while at others only an approximate value has been added (the source's approximate baseline for each station is reproduced in the comment block of the IAGA2002 output). That baseline is what the source supplies for transforming the reported elements: D is needed to transform the HEZ variation data to the widely used XYZ orientation, and H to convert E-variations in nT to variations in minutes of arc. Use the data for variations, not for absolute levels, and do not compare levels between stations or across time without establishing your own baseline. The data were collected for real-time monitoring and are served as recorded: no noise removal, spike rejection or baseline control has been applied. Caution: timestamps may be inaccurate during periods when GPS timing or the network connection was unavailable and the recording PC's clock was used instead. Timestamps are bin centers (timeStampLocation=center). Real-time monitoring data, unprocessed. label: Z name: geomagneticFieldZ provider: hapi speasy_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_mya/geomagneticFieldZ stable_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_mya/geomagneticFieldZ start_date: 2010-06-01T00:00:00Z stop_date: 2023-09-19T00:00:00Z type: double uid: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec_kyo_mya/geomagneticFieldZ units: nT

Data_HEEA__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD array_dimension: 2:32, 1:12, 0:2 cat_description: C3 PITCH_FULL (PSD), 12 PA bins, HEEA sensor caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: PITCH_FULL fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This data product contains rebinned pitch angle distribution snap-shots for 3 different energy ranges: top, overlap (LEEA), overlap (HEEA), and bottom, for the Cluster C3 spacecraft. Only MAR and HAR sweep modes are included. label_axis: Phase Space Density parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 3:Sweep_Energy_HEEA__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD, 2:Sweep_PitchAngle_HEEA__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD, 1:Sweep_Azimuth_HEEA__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD, 0:time_tags__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD parameter_id: Data_HEEA__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD parameter_label:  parameter_representation:  property: Phase_Space_Density provider: csa quality: Status_Quality__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD scale_type:  si_conversion: 1.0E-18>s^3 m^-6 significant_digits: 8 speasy_id: csa/C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD/Data_HEEA__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD stable_id: csa/C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD/Data_HEEA__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  uid: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD/Data_HEEA__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_PSD units: s^3/km^6 value_type: FLOAT

Data__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXLARH_DPFlux array_dimension: 2:64, 1:12, 0:16 cat_description: C3 PITCH_3DXLAR HEEA (DPFlux), 12 PA bins caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXLARH_DPFlux dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXLARH_DPFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: PITCH_3DXLAR fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This data product contains rebinned pitch angle distributions from a single (HEEA) sensor for the Cluster C3 spacecraft. The data is provided in the same format as the 3D data, except that the 12 polar zones are rebinned into 12 pitch angle zones using ground calibrated magnetic field data. Only LAR sweep modes is included. label_axis: Diff. E__C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 array_dimension: 0:1 cat_description: Calibrated AC WBD Electric Field caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system: Instrument data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 dataset_id: C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electric_Field error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: WBD AC Electric Field fillval: -1.0e31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 WBD Experiment on Cluster C3 High time resolution calibrated waveform data sampled in one of 3 frequency bands in the range 0-577 kHz along one axis using either an electric field antenna or a magnetic search coil sensor.  The dataset also includes instrument mode, data quality and the angles required to orient the measurement with respect to the magnetic field and to the GSE coordinate system. ... The Burst Mode (BM) dataset contains the data that has been returned via the main Cluster telemetry system using BM2. The format of the file is the same as the waveform product returned via the dedicated communication link except that there is an additional paramter providing information on the data sampling and bandwidth relevant for the BM2 link. ... CALIBRATION: ... The procedure used in computing the calibrated Electric Field and Magnetic Field values found in this file can be obtained from the document CAA-EST-CR-WBD (Calibration Report of the WBD Measurements in the Cluster Science Archive). In the same document are decribed the procedures to calculate power spectra and to invert the calibration to obtain raw instrument data. ... Bandwidth   Sample Rate ---------   ------------ 0.1 - 9.5 kHz      27.443 kHz 0.1 - 19 kHz       54.886 kHz 0.7 - 77 kHz      219.544 kHz ... COORDINATE SYSTEM USED: ... The data contain a projection of the electric or magnetic field vector into the direction of the selected receiving antenna (indicated by the Antenna variable). While Bx magnetic antenna points along the spin axis of the spacecraft, antennas Ey, Ez and By are in the spin plane and rotate with spacecraft spin. The instantaneous direction of the antenna in GSE coordinate system can be calculated from the angles in variables Ant_Xgse_Angle and Ant_YZgse_Angle. ... The burst mode file has the same format as the standard WBD waveform with the addition of an additional paramter which describes the details of the mode specification. The paramter can take one of ten values as specified below 0 = Duty Cycled 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 27.443 kHz 1 = Duty Cycled 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 27.443 kHz 2 = Duty Cycled 19 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 54.886 kHz 3 = Duty Cycled 19 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 54.886 kHz 4 = Duty Cycled 77 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 219.544 kHz 5 = Duty Cycled 77 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 219.544 kHz 6 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, roll-off at 3.2 kHz, SR 9.148 kHz 7 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, optimized roll-off at 4.2 kHz, SR 9.148 kHz 8 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, roll-off at 2.5 kHz, SR 6.861 kHz 9 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, optimized roll-off at 3.1 kHz, SR 6.861 kHz ... label_axis: E-field parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 0:time_tags__C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 parameter_id: E__C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 parameter_label:  parameter_representation:  property: Magnitude provider: csa quality: 3 scale_type:  si_conversion: 1.0e-3>V m^-1 significant_digits: 7 speasy_id: csa/C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/E__C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 stable_id: csa/C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/E__C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  uid: C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/E__C3_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 units: mV/m value_type: FLOAT

n_3d_ions__C4_CP_CIS_CODIF_RPA_He1_PEF array_dimension: 2:16, 1:16, 0:8 cat_description: CIS-CODIF 3D RPA Helium+ distribution caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C4_CP_CIS-CODIF_RPA_He1_PEF dataset_id: C4_CP_CIS-CODIF_RPA_He1_PEF delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Helium+ error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: CIS-CODIF 3D RPA Helium+ distribution fillval: -1e+31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-4 (Tango) Launched: 9 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 4 COSPAR ID: 2000-045B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26464 CSDS Code: C4 ESOC FD code: S4 ESA Flight Model Number: FM8 CIS COmposition DIstribution Function analyser on Cluster C4. CODIF consists of two sections, each with a 180 degrees field of view: A high-sensitivity (HS) side and a low-sensitivity (LS) side. The HS side is best adapted for low-flux populations, as for example in the magnetosphere or the upstreaming populations in the foreshock region. The LS side is best adapted for high-flux populations, as for example in the magnetosheath and in the solar wind (solar wind beam), where the HS side can saturate. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. THSVD_mfa__C2_CP_STA_PPP array_dimension: 0:27 cat_description: Polar Angle of the direction of propagation in MFA coordinate system (SVD). caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C2_CP_STA_PPP dataset_id: C2_CP_STA_PPP delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Compound error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Polar Angle (SVD) in MFA coordinate system fillval: -999. fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-2 (Salsa) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 2 COSPAR ID: 2000-041B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26411 CSDS Code: C2 ESOC FD code: S2 ESA Flight Model Number: FM6 The STAFF Spectrum Analyser (SA) combines the 3 magnetic components of the waves with the two electric components measured by the EFW experiment to calculate in real time the 5x5 Hermitian cross-spectral matrix at 27 frequencies distributed logarithmically in the frequency range 8 Hz to 4 kHz. The components in the spin plane are despun onboard. The five auto-spectral power estimates are obtained with a dynamic range of approximately 100 dB and an average amplitude resolution of 0.38 dB. The 10 cross-spectral power estimates are normalised to give the coherence. The precision of the phase depends upon the magnitude of the coherence: for a signal with magnitude in the highest bin, it is approximately 5 degree close to 0 degree, 180 degree, and +/- 90 degree, increasing to about 10 degree midway between these angles. The Spectrum Analyser can work in different modes, in Burst Mode the analysis is performed in the frequency range 64 Hz - 4 kHz. Polarization and propagation parameters derived from singular value decomposition (SVD) method of the cross-spectral matrix (sm) using the PRASSADCO program with 4s (or 1s) time resolution at 27 (or 18) logarithmically distributed frequencies between either 8 (or 64) Hz to 4 kHz. The SVD  method is described in Santolik et al (2003). The parameters calculated from the three magnetic components are THSVD, PHSVD, ELLSVD,POLSVD and BSUM. BSUM is the sum of the three magnetic auto-power spectra. When BSUM is inferior to 1.0E-09 nT^2/Hz, the calculation of the other magnetic dependant parameters is meaningless. The theta and phi variables are respectively the wave vector polar and azimuthal angles in MFA coordinate system. PVSIGN is the direction of the Poynting vector component parallel to the magnetic field. It is given only when E component is valid. Positive (negative) values correspond to a parallel (anti-parallel) Z-component of the Poynting vector. ESUM is the the sum of auto-power spectra of the two electric antennae. The calculation of PVSIGN is meaningless when BSUM is inferior to 1.0E-09 nT^2/Hz, and ESUM to 3.0E-09mv^2m^-2/Hz. The change of coordinate system has been done using FGM 5VPS data. label_axis: THSVD parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 1:Frequency__C2_CP_STA_PPP, 0:Time__C2_CP_STA_PPP parameter_id: THSVD_mfa__C2_CP_STA_PPP parameter_label:  parameter_representation:  property: Direction provider: csa quality: 3 scale_type:  si_conversion: 0.01745>rad significant_digits: 3 speasy_id: csa/C2_CP_STA_PPP/THSVD_mfa__C2_CP_STA_PPP stable_id: csa/C2_CP_STA_PPP/THSVD_mfa__C2_CP_STA_PPP start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  uid: C2_CP_STA_PPP/THSVD_mfa__C2_CP_STA_PPP units: deg value_type: FLOAT

sc_at3_long__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT array_dimension: 0:1 cat_description: Longitude of spacecraft spin axis, angle from Ecliptic Plane (GSE), taken from CSDS SP caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system: GSE data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Observatory error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Longitude of spacecraft spin axis, angle from Ecliptic Plane (GSE) fillval: -1e+31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This dataset has been derived from C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS dataset. The velocity moments in the present dataset are given in both GSE and ISR2 coordinate systems in inertial frame whereas in C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS they are in GSE in spacecraft frame. In addition spin-averaged E-field is given in both ISR2 and GSE in inertial frame. NOTE: PI has not validated this product. label_axis: longitude parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 0:time_tags__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT parameter_id: sc_at3_long__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT parameter_label:  parameter_representation:  property: Magnitude provider: csa quality: 3 scale_type:  si_conversion: 0.01745>rad significant_digits: 6 speasy_id: csa/C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT/sc_at3_long__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT stable_id: csa/C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT/sc_at3_long__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT start_date: 2000-09-27T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  tensor_order: 1 uid: C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT/sc_at3_long__C3_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT units: deg value_type: FLOAT

DoubleStar-1 (D1) Launched: 2003-12-29 COSPAR ID: 2003-061A USSPACECOM catalogue number 28140 DSDS Code: T1 Orbit: 570 x 78,970 km, inclination 28.5 degrees to the equator  Double Star 1 (also known as Tan Ce 1, and TC 1) is a Sino-European (CSNA-ESA) satellite that was launched by a Long March 2C/SM rocket from Xichang Satellite Launch Center in the Sichuan province of China (PRC) at 19:06 UT on 29 December 2003. The 330 kg, 260 W satellite is cylindrical, with a diameter of 2.1 m, a height of 1.4 m, and spins at a rate of 15 rpm. It carries eight instruments to probe Earth's magnetosphere, five from ESA and three from CNSA. The ESA instruments are legacies from ESA's Cluster mission. The data from all instruments will be stored on-board and dumped over three grounds stations: Shanghai and Beifing in China, and Villafranca in Spain. There will be coordination between the Cluster and Double Star missions. For more information, see https://sci.esa.int/web/double-star  In the early morning on 14 October 2007, the satellite re-entered the Earth's atmosphere and disintegrated during its descent. BSUM__C2_CP_STA_PPP array_dimension: 0:27 cat_description: Sum of the three magnetic auto-power spectra. caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C2_CP_STA_PPP dataset_id: C2_CP_STA_PPP delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Compound error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Sum of the three magnetic auto-power spectra. fillval: -1.00E+31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-2 (Salsa) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 2 COSPAR ID: 2000-041B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26411 CSDS Code: C2 ESOC FD code: S2 ESA Flight Model Number: FM6 The STAFF Spectrum Analyser (SA) combines the 3 magnetic components of the waves with the two electric components measured by the EFW experiment to calculate in real time the 5x5 Hermitian cross-spectral matrix at 27 frequencies distributed logarithmically in the frequency range 8 Hz to 4 kHz. The components in the spin plane are despun onboard. The five auto-spectral power estimates are obtained with a dynamic range of approximately 100 dB and an average amplitude resolution of 0.38 dB. The 10 cross-spectral power estimates are normalised to give the coherence. The precision of the phase depends upon the magnitude of the coherence: for a signal with magnitude in the highest bin, it is approximately 5 degree close to 0 degree, 180 degree, and +/- 90 degree, increasing to about 10 degree midway between these angles. The Spectrum Analyser can work in different modes, in Burst Mode the analysis is performed in the frequency range 64 Hz - 4 kHz. Polarization and propagation parameters derived from singular value decomposition (SVD) method of the cross-spectral matrix (sm) using the PRASSADCO program with 4s (or 1s) time resolution at 27 (or 18) logarithmically distributed frequencies between either 8 (or 64) Hz to 4 kHz. The SVD  method is described in Santolik et al (2003). The parameters calculated from the three magnetic components are THSVD, PHSVD, ELLSVD,POLSVD and BSUM. BSUM is the sum of the three magnetic auto-power spectra. When BSUM is inferior to 1.0E-09 nT^2/Hz, the calculation of the other magnetic dependant parameters is meaningless. The theta and phi variables are respectively the wave vector polar and azimuthal angles in MFA coordinate system. PVSIGN is the direction of the Poynting vector component parallel to the magnetic field. It is given only when E component is valid. Positive (negative) values correspond to a parallel (anti-parallel) Z-component of the Poynting vector. ESUM is the the sum of auto-power spectra of the two electric antennae. The calculation of PVSIGN is meaningless when BSUM is inferior to 1.0E-09 nT^2/Hz, and ESUM to 3.0E-09mv^2m^-2/Hz. The change of coordinate system has been done using FGM 5VPS data. label_axis: BSUM parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 1:Frequency__C2_CP_STA_PPP, 0:Time__C2_CP_STA_PPP parameter_id: BSUM__C2_CP_STA_PPP parameter_label:  parameter_representation:  property: Magnitude provider: csa quality: 3 scale_type:  si_conversion: 1.0E-18>T^2 Hz^-1 significant_digits: 3 speasy_id: csa/C2_CP_STA_PPP/BSUM__C2_CP_STA_PPP stable_id: csa/C2_CP_STA_PPP/BSUM__C2_CP_STA_PPP start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  uid: C2_CP_STA_PPP/BSUM__C2_CP_STA_PPP units: nT^2 Hz^-1 value_type: FLOAT

Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts array_dimension: 2:32, 1:12, 0:64 cat_description: C3 3DXPA HEEA (cnts), 12 Zones caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DXPA fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This dataset contains all available 3DXPA data from the PEACE HEEA sensor on the Cluster C3 spacecraft in MAR and HAR modes only. The 3DXPA product contains only the 3DX azimuths that are most closely aligned parallel and anti-parallel with the onboard magnetic field direction.  It is up to the user to decide which azimuth is closest to the real field directions by examining the (ground produced) Pitch Angle data included in the file.  For the MAR/HAR modes the maximum extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will be 8 azimuths x 12 polar angles x 32 energy bins.  The exact energy and azimuth binning is determined from the specific mode (MAR/HAR) the Cluster C3 spacecraft in LAR mode only. The 3DXLAR product contains only the 3DX azimuths that are aligned parallel and anti-parallel with the onboard magnetic field direction.  For the LAR mode the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will be 2 azimuths x 12 polar angles x 64 energy bins. label_axis: Counts/accum. parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 3:Sweep_Energy__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts, 2:Sweep_Polar__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts, 1:Sweep_Azimuth__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts, 0:time_tags__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts parameter_id: Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts parameter_label:  parameter_representation:  property: Raw_Particle_Counts provider: csa quality: Status_Quality__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts scale_type:  si_conversion: 1>(counts/accumulation) unitless significant_digits: 8 speasy_id: csa/C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts/Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts stable_id: csa/C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts/Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  uid: C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts/Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXPAH_cnts units: c/acc value_type: FLOAT

BackgroundLevel__C1_CP_PEA_3DRH_DPFlux array_dimension: 2:16, 1:6, 0:16 cat_description: Background level data for 'Data__C1_CP_PEA_3DRH_DPFlux' caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C1_CP_PEA_3DRH_DPFlux dataset_id: C1_CP_PEA_3DRH_DPFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DR background level fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-1 (Rumba) Launched: 09 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 1 COSPAR ID: 2000-045A USSPACECOM catalogue number 26463 CSDS Code: C1 ESOC FD code: S1 ESA Flight Model Number: FM5 The C1 LEEA or C1 HEEA instruments are fully operational and the DPU's are operating nominally in dual processor mode. This dataset contains reduced resolution three dimensional electron distributions (3DR) from the PEACE HEEA sensor on the Cluster C1 spacecraft. This data product is usually produced onboard and is reduced by a factor of 8 from the full resolution 3DF product, but if not telemetered it can also be generated from higher resolution data in ground processing. For all energy sweep modes (LAR/MAR/HAR) the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will always be 16 azimuths x 6 polar angles x 16 energy bins.  For all energy sweep modes, the 12 polar anodes are summed to make 6 anode-pairs. The remaining compression is achieved in the following way: - LAR sums 4 energies to a bin and 1 (3DF) azimuth  to get a single 3DR azimuth. - MAR sums 2 energies to a bin and 2 (3DF) azimuths to get a single 3DR azimuth. - HAR does not sum energy bins but 4 (3DF) azimuths to get a single 3DR azimuth.  The effective time resolution of the data is reduced due to these summations. Where a variable higher resolution dataset was used to generate the 3DR records there may be fill values in some energy bins. label_axis: Diff. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 CIS COmposition DIstribution Function analyser on Cluster C3. CODIF consists of two sections, each with a 180 degrees field of view: A high-sensitivity (HS) side and a low-sensitivity (LS) side. The HS side is best adapted for low-flux populations, as for example in the magnetosphere or the upstreaming populations in the foreshock region. The LS side is best adapted for high-flux populations, as for example in the magnetosheath and in the solar wind (solar wind beam), where the HS side can saturate. The operation of each sensitivity side is mutually exclusive. cf. the CIS User Guide for details This dataset has been derived from C3_CP_CIS-CODIF_HS_H1_MOMENTS dataset. delta_Ez_ISR2__C1_CP_EFW_L2_E3D_INERT array_dimension: 0:1 cat_description: Error of electric field (ISR2) caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system: ISR2>Inverted Despun Spin Reference data_type: Data dataset: C1_CP_EFW_L2_E3D_INERT dataset_id: C1_CP_EFW_L2_E3D_INERT delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electric_Field error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Error of electric field (ISR2) fillval: -1e+31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity: Inertial instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-1 (Rumba) Launched: 09 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 1 COSPAR ID: 2000-045A USSPACECOM catalogue number 26463 CSDS Code: C1 ESOC FD code: S1 ESA Flight Model Number: FM5 Electric Field and Wave (EFW) Experiment on Cluster C1 This dataset contains instantaneous values of the 3-dimensional Electric field vector in the inertial frame (i.e., vxB removed) in the spacecraft coordinate system (ISR2), using EFW electric field data from C1_CP_EFW_L2_E and FGM magnetic field data from C1_CP_FGM_FULL that are interpolated to the time stamps of electric field data. The spin-axis component of the electric field is calculated with assumption of E.B equals 0 and with use of 2 electric field components measured in the spin plane and three magnetic field components. If the magnetic field component along the spin axis is less than 2 nT or the elevation angle of the magnetic field vector from the spacecraft spin plane is less than 15 degrees, the spin-axis electric field component has a FILLVAL.  Detailed quality information is provided as a 16 bit set of flags in the parameter E_bitmask__C1_CP_EFW_L2_E3D_INERT. The meaning of the bits is as follows (LSB numbering starting at 0): Bit  0: Reset. Bit  1: Bad bias. Bit  2: Probe latchup. Bit  3: Low density saturation (-68V). Bit  4: Sweep (collection and dump). Bit  5: Burst dump. Bit  6: Non-standard operations (NS_OPS). Bit  7: Manual flag. Bit  8: Not used. Bit  9: Not used. Bit 10: Solar wind wake correction applied. Bit 11: Lobe wake. Bit 12: Plasmaspheric wake. Bit 13: Whisper operating. Bit 14: Saturation due to high bias current. Bit 15: Bias current DAC not responding correctly. The magnetic waveform unit (SC) comprises low-pass filters at either 10 Hz or 180 Hz, selected by remote in accordance with the telemetry rate (Normal bit rate or Burst Mode). The sampling rates are respectively 25 and 450 Hz. The output signals are digitised in a real 16-bit analog-to-digital converter. Owing to telemetry limitations, a reduction of the dynamic data range from 16 to 12 bits is performed inside DWP. The principle is to transmit the full 16-bit word at the beginning of each telemetry packet, and later the difference between the successive samples, coded on 12 bits. This dataset contains calibrated Complex Spectra (CS) of the magnetic field measured by STAFF-SC from 0.1Hz to 12.5Hz with a resolution of 0.097657Hz x 10.24s, in NBR mode on the Cluster C4 spacecraft. This product is given in Geocentric Solar Ecliptic (GSE) coordinate system. Data calibration is performed using a moving window of 256 points in NBR mode This value was chosen as the best compromise for routine production. BackgroundLevel__C4_CP_PEA_3DXH_DPFlux array_dimension: 2:32, 1:12, 0:64 cat_description: Background level data for 'Data__C4_CP_PEA_3DXH_DPFlux' caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C4_CP_PEA_3DXH_DPFlux dataset_id: C4_CP_PEA_3DXH_DPFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DX background level fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-4 (Tango) Launched: 9 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 4 COSPAR ID: 2000-045B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26464 CSDS Code: C4 ESOC FD code: S4 ESA Flight Model Number: FM8 The C4 LEEA or C4 HEEA instruments are fully operational and the DPU's are operating nominally in dual processor mode. This dataset contains all available 3DF, 3DX and 3DXE data from the PEACE HEEA sensor on the Cluster C4 spacecraft in HAR mode only. This dataset is NOT summed over polar angle but can in some cases be summed over energy.  Including: - The 3DF dataset contains FULL resolution three dimensional electron distribution. - The 3DX1 and 3DX2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution with no summing. - The 3DXE1 and 3DXE2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution which has been summed over pairs of ENERGY bins.  For the MAR/HAR modes the maximum extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will be 64 azimuths x 12 polar angles x 32 energy bins.  The exact energy and azimuth binning is determined from the specific mode (MAR/HAR). label_axis: Diff. Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 array_dimension: 0:1 cat_description: Total angle between antenna used for WBD measurement and measured B field direction caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 dataset_id: C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Instrument error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Antenna-B Field Total Angle fillval: -1.0E+31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-4 (Tango) Launched: 9 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 4 COSPAR ID: 2000-045B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26464 CSDS Code: C4 ESOC FD code: S4 ESA Flight Model Number: FM8 WBD Experiment on Cluster C4 High time resolution calibrated waveform data sampled in one of 3 frequency bands in the range 0-577 kHz along one axis using either an electric field antenna or a magnetic search coil sensor.  The dataset also includes instrument mode, data quality and the angles required to orient the measurement with respect to the magnetic field and to the GSE coordinate system. ... The Burst Mode (BM) dataset contains the data that has been returned via the main Cluster telemetry system using BM2. The format of the file is the same as the waveform product returned via the dedicated communication link except that there is an additional paramter providing information on the data sampling and bandwidth relevant for the BM2 link. ... CALIBRATION: ... The procedure used in computing the calibrated Electric Field and Magnetic Field values found in this file can be obtained from the document CAA-EST-CR-WBD (Calibration Report of the WBD Measurements in the Cluster Science Archive). In the same document are decribed the procedures to calculate power spectra and to invert the calibration to obtain raw instrument data. ... Bandwidth   Sample Rate ---------   ------------ 0.1 - 9.5 kHz      27.443 kHz 0.1 - 19 kHz       54.886 kHz 0.7 - 77 kHz      219.544 kHz ... COORDINATE SYSTEM USED: ... The data contain a projection of the electric or magnetic field vector into the direction of the selected receiving antenna (indicated by the Antenna variable). While Bx magnetic antenna points along the spin axis of the spacecraft, antennas Ey, Ez and By are in the spin plane and rotate with spacecraft spin. The instantaneous direction of the antenna in GSE coordinate system can be calculated from the angles in variables Ant_Xgse_Angle and Ant_YZgse_Angle. ... The burst mode file has the same format as the standard WBD waveform with the addition of an additional paramter which describes the details of the mode specification. The paramter can take one of ten values as specified below 0 = Duty Cycled 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 27.443 kHz 1 = Duty Cycled 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 27.443 kHz 2 = Duty Cycled 19 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 54.886 kHz 3 = Duty Cycled 19 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 54.886 kHz 4 = Duty Cycled 77 kHz, 1-in-3, Sample Rate 219.544 kHz 5 = Duty Cycled 77 kHz, 1-in-4, Sample Rate 219.544 kHz 6 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, roll-off at 3.2 kHz, SR 9.148 kHz 7 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-3, optimized roll-off at 4.2 kHz, SR 9.148 kHz 8 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, roll-off at 2.5 kHz, SR 6.861 kHz 9 = Digital Filtered 9.5 kHz, 1-in-4, optimized roll-off at 3.1 kHz, SR 6.861 kHz ... label_axis: Ant-B Ang parameter_data:  parameter_dependency: 0:time_tags__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 parameter_id: Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 parameter_label:  parameter_representation:  property: Status provider: csa quality: 0 scale_type:  si_conversion: 0.01745>rad significant_digits: 5 speasy_id: csa/C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 stable_id: csa/C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 start_date: 2000-07-16T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2024-09-30T00:00:00.000Z target_system:  uid: C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2/Ant_B_Field_Angle__C4_CP_WBD_WAVEFORM_BM2 units: degrees value_type: FLOAT

The mission is made of two spacecraft, the equatorial DoubleStar-1 (D1) and the Polar DoubleStar-2 (D2) to investigate the magnetospheric global processes and their response to the interplanetary disturbances in conjunction with the Cluster mission. DoubleStar-1 (D1) Launched: 2003-12-29 COSPAR ID: 2003-061A USSPACECOM catalogue number 28140 DSDS Code: T1 Orbit: 570 x 78,970 km, inclination 28.5 degrees to the equator  Double Star 1 (also known as Tan Ce 1, and TC 1) is a Sino-European (CSNA-ESA) satellite that was launched by a Long March 2C/SM rocket from Xichang Satellite Launch Center in the Sichuan province of China (PRC) at 19:06 UT on 29 December 2003. The 330 kg, 260 W satellite is cylindrical, with a diameter of 2.1 m, a height of 1.4 m, and spins at a rate of 15 rpm. It carries eight instruments to probe Earth's magnetosphere, five from ESA and three from CNSA. The ESA instruments are legacies from ESA's Cluster mission. The data from all instruments will be stored on-board and dumped over three grounds stations: Shanghai and Beifing in China, and Villafranca in Spain. There will be coordination between the Cluster and Double Star missions. For more information, see https://sci.esa.int/web/double-star  In the early morning on 14 October 2007, the satellite re-entered the Earth's atmosphere and disintegrated during its descent.
