BackgroundLevel__C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:64, 1:12, 0:16 cat_description: Background level data for 'Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux' caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DXLAR background level fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This dataset contains all available 3DF, 3DX and 3DXE data from the PEACE HEEA sensor on the Cluster C3 spacecraft in LAR mode only. This dataset is NOT summed over polar angle but can in some cases be summed over energy.  Including: - The 3DF dataset contains FULL resolution three dimensional electron distribution. - The 3DX1 and 3DX2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution with no summing. - The 3DXE1 and 3DXE2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution which has been summed over pairs of ENERGY bins.  For the 3DX in LAR mode the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will be 16 azimuths x 12 polar angles x 64 energy bins. label_axis: Diff. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This dataset contains all available 3DF, 3DX and 3DXE data from the PEACE HEEA sensor on the Cluster C3 spacecraft in LAR mode only. This dataset is NOT summed over polar angle but can in some cases be summed over energy.  Including: - The 3DF dataset contains FULL resolution three dimensional electron distribution. - The 3DX1 and 3DX2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution with no summing. - The 3DXE1 and 3DXE2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution which has been summed over pairs of ENERGY bins.  For the 3DX in LAR mode the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will be 16 azimuths x 12 polar angles x 64 energy bins. label_axis: Diff. BackgroundLevel__C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:64, 1:12, 0:16 cat_description: Background level data for 'Data__C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux' caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_3DXLARH_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DXLAR background level fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This dataset contains all available 3DF, 3DX and 3DXE data from the PEACE HEEA sensor on the Cluster C3 spacecraft in LAR mode only. This dataset is NOT summed over polar angle but can in some cases be summed over energy.  Including: - The 3DF dataset contains FULL resolution three dimensional electron distribution. - The 3DX1 and 3DX2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution with no summing. - The 3DXE1 and 3DXE2 datasets contains the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution which has been summed over pairs of ENERGY bins.  For the 3DX in LAR mode the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will be 16 azimuths x 12 polar angles x 64 energy bins. label_axis: Diff. Cluster-1 (Rumba) Launched: 09 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 1 COSPAR ID: 2000-045A USSPACECOM catalogue number 26463 CSDS Code: C1 ESOC FD code: S1 ESA Flight Model Number: FM5 The C1 LEEA or C1 HEEA instruments are fully operational and the DPU's are operating nominally in dual processor mode. This dataset contains all available 3DXP data from the PEACE LEEA sensor on the Cluster C1 spacecraft in LAR mode only. Including: - The 3DXP1 and 3DXP2 datasets which contain the variable resolution three dimensional electron distribution where the 12 polar anodes have been summed to make 6 polar anode-pairs. velocity_par_isr2_inert__C4_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT array_dimension: 0:3 cat_description: Parallel Electron Velocity (ISR2) in inertial frame (units: km/s), calculated from C4_CP_PEA_MOMENTS caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system: ISR2 data_type: Data dataset: C4_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT dataset_id: C4_CP_PEA_MOMENTS_INERT delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Parallel Electron Velocity (ISR2) fillval: -1e31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity: Inertial instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-4 (Tango) Launched: 9 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 4 COSPAR ID: 2000-045B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26464 CSDS Code: C4 ESOC FD code: S4 ESA Flight Model Number: FM8 The C4 LEEA or C4 HEEA instruments are fully operational and the DPU's are operating nominally in dual processor mode. This dataset has been derived from C4_CP_PEA_MOMENTS dataset. The velocity moments in the present dataset are given in both GSE and ISR2 coordinate systems in inertial frame whereas in C4_CP_PEA_MOMENTS they are in GSE in spacecraft frame. In addition spin-averaged E-field is given in both ISR2 and GSE in inertial frame. Data_HEEA__C2_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_LAR_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:64, 1:12, 0:2 cat_description: C2 PITCH_FULL_LAR (DEFlux), 12 PA bins, HEEA sensor caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C2_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_LAR_DEFlux dataset_id: C2_CP_PEA_PITCH_FULL_LAR_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: PITCH_FULL_LAR fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-2 (Salsa) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 2 COSPAR ID: 2000-041B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26411 CSDS Code: C2 ESOC FD code: S2 ESA Flight Model Number: FM6 From 15th May 2011 the C2 LEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 2 of 12), while the C2 HEEA instrument is fully operational and the DPU's are operating nominally in dual processor mode. thb_peer_magfQ CATDESC: -----Magnetic Field Vector in DSL (Same time array as Reduced Electron ESA data)  DEPEND_0: thb_peer_epoch DISPLAY_TYPE: time_series FIELDNAM: Magnetic Field Vector in DSL (Same time array as Reduced Electron ESA data) FUNCT: apply_esa_qflag UNITS: nT VIRTUAL: TRUE cdf_type: CDF_DOUBLE dataset: THB_L2_ESA instrument_description: THEMIS THEMIS-B L2 DATA THEMIS-B (P1/ARTEMIS-P1): Electrostatic Analyzer (ESA): Electron/Ion Ground-Calculated Energy Fluxes (ions: 5 eV to 25 keV) electrons: 6 eV to 30 keV) and Moments (density, velocity, pressure, and temperature). Includes FULL, REDUCED and BURST modes. FULL: high angular resolution, low (few min) time resolution. REDUCED: degraded angular resolution, high (approx. 3 sec) time resolution. BURST: high angular resolution, high time resolution; only short bursts of data. BackgroundLevel__C2_CP_PEA_3DRL_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:16, 1:6, 0:16 cat_description: Background level data for 'Data__C2_CP_PEA_3DRL_DEFlux' caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C2_CP_PEA_3DRL_DEFlux dataset_id: C2_CP_PEA_3DRL_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: 3DR background level fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-2 (Salsa) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 2 COSPAR ID: 2000-041B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26411 CSDS Code: C2 ESOC FD code: S2 ESA Flight Model Number: FM6 From 15th May 2011 the C2 LEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 2 of 12), while the C2 HEEA instrument is fully operational and the DPU's are operating nominally in dual processor mode. This dataset contains reduced resolution three dimensional electron distributions (3DR) from the PEACE LEEA sensor on the Cluster C2 spacecraft. This data product is usually produced onboard and is reduced by a factor of 8 from the full resolution 3DF product, but if not telemetered it can also be generated from higher resolution data in ground processing. For all energy sweep modes (LAR/MAR/HAR) the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will always be 16 azimuths x 6 polar angles x 16 energy bins.  For all energy sweep modes, the 12 polar anodes are summed to make 6 anode-pairs. The remaining compression is achieved in the following way: - LAR sums 4 energies to a bin and 1 (3DF) azimuth  to get a single 3DR azimuth. - MAR sums 2 energies to a bin and 2 (3DF) azimuths to get a single 3DR azimuth. - HAR does not sum energy bins but 4 (3DF) azimuths to get a single 3DR azimuth.  The effective time resolution of the data is reduced due to these summations. Where a variable higher resolution dataset was used to generate the 3DR records there may be fill values in some energy bins. label_axis: Diff. This data product is usually produced onboard and is reduced by a factor of 8 from the full resolution 3DF product, but if not telemetered it can also be generated from higher resolution data in ground processing. For all energy sweep modes (LAR/MAR/HAR) the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will always be 16 azimuths x 6 polar angles x 16 energy bins. This data product is usually produced onboard and is reduced by a factor of 8 from the full resolution 3DF product, but if not telemetered it can also be generated from higher resolution data in ground processing. For all energy sweep modes (LAR/MAR/HAR) the extent of the data structure (including flyback information) will always be 16 azimuths x 6 polar angles x 16 energy bins.  For all energy sweep modes, the 12 polar anodes are summed to make 6 anode-pairs. The remaining compression is achieved in the following way: - LAR sums 4 energies to a bin and 1 (3DF) azimuth  to get a single 3DR azimuth. - MAR sums 2 energies to a bin and 2 (3DF) azimuths to get a single 3DR azimuth. - HAR does not sum energy bins but 4 (3DF) azimuths to get a single 3DR azimuth.  The effective time resolution of the data is reduced due to these summations. Where a variable higher resolution dataset was used to generate the 3DR records there may be fill values in some energy bins. label_axis: Diff. density__C4_CP_CIS_CODIF_LS_He1_MOMENTS array_dimension:  cat_description: Density (in cm^-3) caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C4_CP_CIS-CODIF_LS_He1_MOMENTS dataset_id: C4_CP_CIS-CODIF_LS_He1_MOMENTS delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Helium+ error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: Density fillval: -1e31 fluctuations:  frame:  frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-4 (Tango) Launched: 9 Aug 2000 ESA Number: 4 COSPAR ID: 2000-045B USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26464 CSDS Code: C4 ESOC FD code: S4 ESA Flight Model Number: FM8 CIS COmposition DIstribution Function analyser on Cluster C4. CODIF consists of two sections, each with a 180 degrees field of view: A high-sensitivity (HS) side and a low-sensitivity (LS) side. Data__C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXH_DEFlux array_dimension: 2:32, 1:12, 0:64 cat_description: C3 PITCH_3DX HEEA (DEFlux), 12 PA bins caveat:  compound:  compound_definition:  coordinate_system:  data_type: Data dataset: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXH_DEFlux dataset_id: C3_CP_PEA_PITCH_3DXH_DEFlux delta_minus:  delta_plus:  display_type:  entity: Electron error_minus:  error_plus:  field_name: PITCH_3DX fillval: -1 fluctuations:  frame: array>na frame_origin:  frame_velocity:  instrument_description: The aim of the Cluster mission is to study small-scale structures of the magnetosphere and its environment in three dimensions. To achieve this, Cluster is constituted of four identical spacecraft that will flight in a tetrahedral configuration. The separation distances between the spacecraft will be varied between ~3 km and 67 000 km, according to the key scientific regions. Cluster-3 (Samba) Launched: 16 Jul 2000 ESA Number: 3 COSPAR ID: 2000-041A USSPACECOM catalogue number: 26410 CSDS Code: C3 ESOC FD code: S3 ESA Flight Model Number: FM7 From 22nd Aug 2005 the C3 HEEA instrument has an individual broken anode (anode 3 of 12), while the C3 LEEA instrument is fully operational. C3 was switched from dual-processor to single-processor mode PEACE DPU operations in May 2013 and has since operated successfully. In single processor mode, some data products are not available, including on-board moments and 3DX from HEEA. On-board pitch angles are not working correctly. Also, for certain products, the first spin of data after a mode change has bad values. There is a sensor ID error in the raw C3 3DX data produced with single processor code. 3DX data is available from LEEA but is labelled as HEEA. We handle these issues by manipulating the raw data stream. Specifically, we rename the 3DX Sensor ID to LEEA and we remove the first spin of data after a mode change for the affected data products. As errors are corrected at the raw data level hence, no changes are required to CAA production codes. This data product contains rebinned pitch angle distributions from a single (HEEA) sensor for the Cluster C3 spacecraft. The data is provided in the same format as the 3D data, except that the 12 polar zones are rebinned into 12 pitch angle zones using ground calibrated magnetic field data. Only MAR and HAR sweep modes are included. label_axis: Diff. geomagneticFieldH dataset: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec0p1_kny description: Horizontal VARIATION along the magnetic meridian (northward+), in nT. Not an absolute value: no baseline is included. Not corrected for the frequency response of the recording system. fill: 99999.0 instrument_description: HAPI server for the World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. Provides geomagnetic indices and geomagnetic observatory data. Kanoya (KNY) 0.1-second geomagnetic field variations (H, E, Z) recorded by the Kakioka Magnetic Observatory, Japan Meteorological Agency. H, E and Z are VARIATION components in nT, where H is along the magnetic meridian (northward+), E is the magnetic eastward variation in nT (not minutes of arc) and Z is vertical (downward+). They are not absolute field measurements and carry no baseline: use them for variations, not for absolute levels, and do not compare levels between stations or across time. The values are served as recorded and are NOT corrected for the frequency response of the recording system: the source supplies sensitivity tables (amplitude and phase against period, 1 to 200 s) whose amplitude factors are close to 1 at periods of a few to tens of seconds but grow to about 3 at 200 s, so long-period variations are recorded smaller than they are. Timestamps are the sample times of the source (timeStampLocation=center). Variation data without baseline, as recorded. label: H name: geomagneticFieldH provider: hapi speasy_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec0p1_kny/geomagneticFieldH stable_id: hapi/wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec0p1_kny/geomagneticFieldH start_date: 1996-06-01T00:00:00.000Z stop_date: 2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z type: double uid: wdc_kyoto_hapi/sec0p1_kny/geomagneticFieldH units: nT x_digits: 3
